Vision Transformers, on Real Photos.zh: 视觉 Transformer：在真实照片上运行

A pretrained @@T0@@MobileNet&nbsp;v2@@T1.zh: 一个预训练的 @@T0@@MobileNet v2@@T1@@ 在你的浏览器中运行，将你照片的每个 patch 转成真实的 1024 维特征向量。我们以这些真实特征充当 Transformer 编码器模块的 Q/K/V，在其上计算货真价实的点积 softmax 注意力，并把结果绘制回照片之上。下文没有任何内容是合成的。
A pretrained @@T0@@MobileNet&nbsp;v2@@T1.src: A pretrained MobileNet v2 runs in your browser to turn every patch of your photo into a real 1024-dimensional feature vector. We use those real features as stand-ins for the Q/K/V of a Transformer encoder block, compute honest dot-product softmax attention over them, and paint the result back on the photo. Nothing below is synthesised.

From CNNs to a sentence of patches.zh: 从 CNN 到「由 patch 构成的句子」
From CNNs to a sentence of patches.src: From CNNs to a sentence of patches

A CNN processes an image by sliding smal.zh: CNN 通过逐层在邻近像素上滑动小卷积核来处理图像。它的先验——局部性、平移等变性、多尺度金字塔——都是手工设定的。@@T0@@视觉 Transformer@@T1@@ 则把这一切统统舍弃：它将图像切成互不重叠的 patch，把每个 patch 展平为向量，再将这个序列送入一个标准的 Transformer。没有卷积，也没有池化——只有自注意力。
A CNN processes an image by sliding smal.src: A CNN processes an image by sliding small kernels over nearby pixels, layer after layer. Its priors—locality, translation equivariance, a pyramid of scales—are hand-wired. A Vision Transformer tosses all of that. It chops the image into non-overlapping patches, flattens each into a vector, and drops the sequence into a vanilla Transformer. No convolutions, no pooling—just self-attention.

A production ViT (@@T0@@vit-base-patch16.zh: 生产级的 ViT（@@T0@@vit-base-patch16@@T1@@、@@T2@@DINOv2@@T3@@）目前尚不易在浏览器中运行，但真实的 @@T4@@MobileNet v2@@T5@@ 可以，而且关键在于它在倒数第二层的空间特征图是一个 7×7×1280 的张量——即在 ImageNet 上学习得到的、7×7 网格的真实 1280 维向量。凡是在 ViT 中本应使用 patch 嵌入的 Q/K/V 投影之处，我们都改用这些向量。其中的数学完全一致：真实特征、真实点积、真实 softmax。
A production ViT (@@T0@@vit-base-patch16.src: A production ViT (vit-base-patch16, DINOv2) doesn't run easily in-browser yet, but a real MobileNet v2 does, and crucially its spatial feature map at the penultimate layer is a 7×7×1280 tensor—i.e. a 7×7 grid of real 1280-dim vectors learned from ImageNet. We use those vectors wherever ViT would normally use Q/K/V projections of patch embeddings. The math is identical: real features, real dot products, real softmax.

The first&mdash;and really the only imag.zh: ViT 中第一个——实际上也是唯一一个与图像相关的——步骤，是把输入切分成大小相等的 patch 网格。对于 224×224 的图像、patch 尺寸为 16×16 时，得到 14×14 = 196 的 patch 网格。这个网格就是 Transformer 所消费的「句子」。
The first&mdash;and really the only imag.src:
The first—and really the only image-specific—step in a
          ViT is splitting the input into a grid of equal patches. For a
          224×224 image with 16×16 patches you get a
          14×14 = 196 patch grid. That grid is the "sentence" the
          Transformer consumes.

Image with patch grid overlay. Click any.zh: 叠加 patch 网格的图像。点击任意 patch。
Image with patch grid overlay. Click any.src: Image with patch grid overlay. Click any patch.

@@T0@@Patch-size tradeoff.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@Patch 尺寸的权衡。@@T1@@
              更小的 patch 意味着更多词元，空间分辨率更精细，但注意力开销呈二次增长。更大的 patch 意味着更少词元，但空间推理更模糊。ViT-Base 在 224×224 图像上使用 16×16 的 patch → 196 个词元。
@@T0@@Patch-size tradeoff.@@T1@@\n.src: Patch-size tradeoff. Smaller patches = more tokens = finer spatial resolution but quadratic attention cost. Larger patches = fewer tokens but blurrier spatial reasoning. ViT-Base used 16×16 on 224×224 images → 196 tokens.

Flatten each patch into a vector.zh: 将每个 patch 展平为向量
Flatten each patch into a vector.src: Flatten each patch into a vector

A patch is a tiny image: $P \\times P$ p.zh: 一个 patch 就是一幅微小的图像：$P \times P$ 个像素，每个像素含 3 个 RGB 通道。ViT 只是按光栅扫描顺序读取这 $3 P^2$ 个数：
A patch is a tiny image: $P \\times P$ p.src:
A patch is a tiny image: $P \times P$ pixels, each with 3 RGB
          channels. The ViT just reads the $3 P^2$ numbers in raster order:

A learned $D \\times 3P^2$ projection ma.zh: 随后，一个学习得到的 $D \times 3P^2$ 投影矩阵将其映射到 Transformer 的隐藏维度 $D$。点击第 1 步中或下方的某个 patch，即可查看其展平后的原始数值。
A learned $D \\times 3P^2$ projection ma.src:
A learned $D \times 3P^2$ projection matrix then maps this to the
          Transformer's hidden dim $D$. Click a patch in Step 1 or

First 12 dims of the flattened raw vecto.zh: 展平原始向量的前 12 个维度
First 12 dims of the flattened raw vecto.src: First 12 dims of the flattened raw vector

@@T0@@Why the projection isn't trivial.@.zh:
@@T0@@为何该投影并不平凡。@@T1@@
          原始展平向量过于底层，它不过是像素亮度而已。$D$ 维投影会学习这些像素的哪些线性组合携带有效信号——实践中它最终计算出的类似梯度特征，与 CNN 第一层所做之事相同。在本页中，我们改用真实 MobileNet 主干倒数第二层的特征图，它已学习到足以覆盖数千个 ImageNet 类别的特征。
@@T0@@Why the projection isn't trivial.@.src: Why the projection isn't trivial. The raw flattened vector is too low-level; it's just pixel brightnesses. The $D$-dim projection learns which linear combinations of those pixels carry useful signal—and in practice ends up computing gradient-like features, the same thing the first layer of a CNN does. For this page, we substitute the real MobileNet backbone's penultimate feature map, which has already learned thousands of ImageNet classes worth of features.

Self-attention is permutation-invariant&.zh: 自注意力具有置换不变性——打乱词元的顺序，输出完全相同。这对图像而言是致命的。解决办法成本很低：为每个 patch 词元加上一个学习得到的位置嵌入 $p_i$，使 Transformer 知道它来自何处。
Self-attention is permutation-invariant&.src:
Self-attention is permutation-invariant—shuffle the tokens
          and the output is identical. That's fatal for an image. The fix
          is cheap: add a learned position embedding $p_i$ to each patch
          token so the Transformer knows where it came from.

In Step&nbsp;5 you'll be able to compare.zh: 在第 5 步中，你将能够比较@@T0@@含@@T1@@与@@T2@@不含@@T3@@该位置信号的注意力。若不含位置信号，注意力就退化为纯粹的特征相似度检索——位于不同角落而外观相同的 patch 会获得相同的权重。
In Step&nbsp;5 you'll be able to compare.src: In Step 5 you'll be able to compare attention with vs without this positional signal. Without it, attention becomes a pure feature-similarity search— identical-looking patches in different corners get equal weight.

ViT borrows a BERT trick: prepend a @@T0.zh: ViT 借用了 BERT 的一个技巧：前置一个@@T0@@可学习的 [CLS] 词元@@T1@@，其职责是聚合来自所有 patch 的信息。它背后没有任何像素——只是一个模型学会去使用的自由参数向量。自注意力运行完毕后，CLS 词元的最终嵌入被送入一个小型 MLP，由后者输出类别 logit。
ViT borrows a BERT trick: prepend a @@T0.src: ViT borrows a BERT trick: prepend a learnable [CLS] token whose job is to aggregate information from all patches. It has no pixels behind it—it's a free parameter vector the model learns to use. After self-attention runs, the CLS token's final embedding feeds a small MLP that outputs class logits.

@@T0@@Why a special token, not just an a.zh:
@@T0@@为何要专门设一个词元，而不直接取平均？@@T1@@
          取平均并无不可，较新的模型（DeiT-III、许多 MAE 变体）正是这么做的。可学习的 CLS 只是给模型一份自由的参数预算，让它自行决定@@T2@@如何@@T3@@按类别进行聚合——不同的注意力头可能为标签的不同部分「抓取」不同的 patch。
@@T0@@Why a special token, not just an a.src: Why a special token, not just an average? Averaging is fine, and newer models (DeiT-III, many MAE variants) do exactly that. A learnable CLS just gives the model a free parameter budget to decide how to aggregate per-class—different heads may steal different patches for different parts of the label.

Self-attention: patches listen to patche.zh: 自注意力：patch 相互「倾听」

Here's the payoff. Every token projects.zh: 精彩之处在此。每个词元都将自身投影为 @@T0@@查询（query）@@T1@@、@@T2@@键（key）@@T3@@ 与 @@T4@@值（value）@@T5@@。注意力权重是缩放后 query-key 点积的 softmax，而每个词元的新取值是所有词元取值的加权和：
Here's the payoff. Every token projects.src: Here's the payoff. Every token projects itself into a query, key, and value. Attention weights are a softmax of scaled query-key dot products, and each token's new value is a weighted sum of everybody's values:

Live attention heatmap — on real MobileN.zh: 实时注意力热力图 —— 基于真实 MobileNet 特征
Live attention heatmap — on real MobileN.src: Live attention heatmap — on real MobileNet features

Click any patch below. We use its real 1.zh: 点击下方任意 patch。我们以其真实的 1280 维 MobileNet 特征向量作为查询 $q$，以其他每个 patch 的特征作为键 $k$，并对全部 patch 计算 $q^\top k$ 的 softmax。结果是一幅真实的、基于学习特征的注意力图，绘制回你的照片之上。它与训练好的 ViT 所产出者并不完全相同（这里是 CNN 特征，而非 ViT 的 Q/K 投影），但每一个数都是真实特征上的真实点积——绝非替代品。
Click any patch below. We use its real 1.src:
Click any patch below. We use its real 1280-dim MobileNet feature
          vector as the query $q$, every other patch's feature as a key
          $k$, and compute the softmax of $q^\top k$ over all patches. The
          result is a real learned-feature attention map, drawn back on
          your photo. It's not what a trained ViT would produce exactly
          (it's CNN features, not ViT Q/K projections), but every number
          is a real dot product over real features—not a stand-in.

Click any patch to make it the query..zh: 点击任意 patch，使其成为查询。
Click any patch to make it the query..src: Click any patch to make it the query.

@@T0@@What to try.@@T1@@\n On a.zh:
@@T0@@可以尝试的操作。@@T1@@
          在肖像照上，点击面部的一个 patch——注意力会聚集到其他面部/皮肤 patch 上。在风景照上，点击天空，它会迅速集中到整幅图像中其他天空 patch 上
          （这正是 CNN 难以应对的@@T2@@长程@@T3@@注意力）。关闭位置嵌入（第 3 步），你会看到被关注的 patch 更加遥远，因为仅基于内容的相似度完全忽略了空间布局。
@@T0@@What to try.@@T1@@\n On a.src: What to try. On a portrait, click a patch on the face—attention clusters on the other face/skin patches. On a landscape, click the sky and it snaps to other sky patches across the whole image (long-range attention that CNNs struggle with). Turn off position embeddings (Step 3) and you'll see even farther patches attended to, because the content-only similarity ignores spatial layout.

Stacking attention &mdash; the rollout v.zh: 堆叠注意力 —— rollout 视角

One layer of attention only spreads info.zh: 一层注意力只将信息传播「一跳」。经过第一个模块后，每个 patch 词元都已混入了其他词元的一个加权邻域。经过两个模块后，它混入的是邻域@@T0@@的@@T1@@邻域。感受野随每个模块不断扩张；到第 12 层（ViT-Base 的深度）时，几乎所有 patch 原则上都能「听到」其他任何一个 patch。
One layer of attention only spreads info.src: One layer of attention only spreads information one hop. After the first block, every patch token has mixed in a weighted neighborhood of the others. After two blocks, it has mixed in neighborhoods of neighborhoods. The receptive field grows with every block; by layer 12 (the depth of ViT-Base) almost every patch can in principle hear from every other.

To visualise that, we synthesise $L$ lay.zh: 为将其可视化，我们由你照片的特征合成 $L$ 层。第 1 层具有强烈的局部性偏好（邻近 patch 占主导）；此后每一层都会削弱这一偏好并强化内容相似度。随后我们应用 @@T0@@注意力 rollout@@T1@@ —— 即 Abnar 与 Zuidema（2020）提出的顾及残差的做法 —— 将注意力矩阵相乘，并计入残差流 $A_l \to (A_l + I)/2$：
To visualise that, we synthesise $L$ lay.src: To visualise that, we synthesise $L$ layers from your photo's features. Layer 1 has a strong locality bias (close patches dominate); each subsequent layer relaxes that bias and sharpens content similarity. Then we apply attention rollout — the residual-aware recipe of Abnar & Zuidema, 2020 — multiplying the attention matrices together, accounting for the residual stream $A_l \to (A_l + I)/2$:

Click any patch on the left canvas to ma.zh: 点击左侧画布上的任意 patch，使其成为查询词元。下方每个面板都显示它在所要求深度上的输出注意力。拖动滑块逐层推进，观察被关注的区域如何扩张。
Click any patch on the left canvas to ma.src:
Click any patch on the left canvas to make it the query token.
          Each panel below shows its outgoing attention at the requested
          depth. Drag the slider to step through layers and watch the
          attended region grow.

@@T0@@Why composed attention is more tha.src: Why composed attention is more than each layer alone. A single layer can only mix neighbors. Stacked, attention becomes a random walk through the patch graph — token $i$ at depth $L$ effectively listens to all $j$ reachable in $L$ steps along high-weight edges. That is why ViTs can do long-range reasoning even though every individual attention map looks fairly local.

@@T0@@What we faked vs what's real.@@T1@.zh:
@@T0@@哪些是模拟的，哪些是真实的。@@T1@@
          我们只有一张 MobileNet 特征图，而非 12 个 ViT 层。我们通过在相同特征之上改变位置偏置温度来生成每个「层」—— 这是对 ViT 注意力随深度由局部漂向全局这一观察结果的风格化建模（Caron 等，2021；Raghu 等，2021）。
          rollout 的数学本身则完全依照已发表的做法。
@@T0@@What we faked vs what's real.@@T1@.src: What we faked vs what's real. We have one MobileNet feature map, not 12 ViT layers. We generated each "layer" by varying a position-bias temperature on top of the same features — a stylised model of how ViT attention is observed to drift from local to global with depth (Caron et al., 2021; Raghu et al., 2021). The rollout math itself is exactly the published recipe.

One encoder block of a ViT is: self-atte.zh: ViT 的一个编码器模块为：自注意力 → 残差相加 → LayerNorm → MLP → 残差相加 → LayerNorm。ViT-Base 将其堆叠 12 次。最终的 CLS 词元经过一个单隐藏层的 MLP 头部，产生类别 logit。
One encoder block of a ViT is: self-atte.src:
One encoder block of a ViT is: self-attention → residual
          add → LayerNorm → MLP → residual add →
          LayerNorm. ViT-Base stacks 12 of them. The final CLS token goes
          through a one-hidden-layer MLP head to produce class logits.

Sequence length fed to the Transformer.zh: 送入 Transformer 的序列长度
Sequence length fed to the Transformer.src: Sequence length fed to the Transformer

= @@T0@@1 CLS + N patch tokens@@T1@@.\n.zh:
= @@T0@@1 个 CLS + N 个 patch 词元@@T1@@。
            每个词元都关注其他所有词元；即每层需进行 $N^2$ 次两两比较。
= @@T0@@1 CLS + N patch tokens@@T1@@.\n.src: = 1 CLS + N patch tokens. Every token attends to every other; that's $N^2$ pairwise comparisons per layer.

Compute comparison across patch sizes.zh: 不同 patch 尺寸下的计算量对比

Four things people get wrong about ViTs.zh: 关于 ViT 的四个常见误解
Four things people get wrong about ViTs.src: Four things people get wrong about ViTs

@@T0@@\"ViTs have no inductive bias for.zh:
@@T0@@「ViT 对图像没有任何归纳偏置。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              其归纳偏置确实少于 CNN，但远非没有。patch 嵌入本质上就是步长为 $P$ 的卷积。位置嵌入编码了网格结构。而自注意力本身即是一种平滑、可学习的先验，用以抵抗无意义的置换。
@@T0@@\"ViTs have no inductive bias for.src:
"ViTs have no inductive bias for images."
They have less than a CNN, but far from none. The patch embedding is literally a stride-$P$ convolution. Position embeddings encode the grid. And self-attention itself is a smooth, learnable prior against gibberish permutations.

@@T0@@\"They need hundreds of millions o.zh:
@@T0@@「它们需要数亿张图像。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              @@T3@@最初的@@T4@@ ViT 确实如此，原因在于其归纳偏置较弱。2021 年之后的变体（DeiT、DINOv2、SwiT、MAE 预训练）仅用 ImageNet-1k 训练，即可与 CNN 持平或超越之。对数据的渴求是一种做法上的选择，而非根本性的局限。
@@T0@@\"They need hundreds of millions o.src:
"They need hundreds of millions of images."
The original ViT did, because of its weak inductive bias. Post-2021 variants (DeiT, DINOv2, SwiT, MAE pre-training) train on ImageNet-1k alone and match or beat CNNs. Data hunger was a recipe choice, not a fundamental limit.

@@T0@@\"Attention weights tell you what.zh:
@@T0@@「注意力权重能告诉你模型看到了什么。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              这种想法很诱人，但并不严谨。在深层残差堆叠中，注意力只是众多信号之一。同一个预测可由许多不同的注意力模式支撑，而基于梯度的归因往往与之相左。应把热力图视为提示，而非证据。
@@T0@@\"Attention weights tell you what.src:
"Attention weights tell you what the model sees."
Tempting, but noisy. Attention is one signal among many in a deep residual stack. The same prediction can be supported by many different attention patterns, and gradient attributions frequently disagree. Treat heatmaps as suggestive, not evidence.

@@T0@@\"Smaller patches are always bette.zh:
@@T0@@「patch 越小越好。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              将 patch 尺寸减半，词元数变为四倍，而注意力开销则变成@@T3@@四倍的平方@@T4@@。混合模型（Swin、MaxViT）使用局部注意力窗口，在保持精度的同时免去 $N^2$ 的开销。
@@T0@@\"Smaller patches are always bette.src:
"Smaller patches are always better."
Halving the patch size quadruples the token count and quadruples squared the attention cost. Hybrid models (Swin, MaxViT) use local attention windows to keep the precision without the $N^2$ bill.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n A.zh:
@@T0@@最终要点。@@T1@@
          视觉 Transformer 就是一个 patch 词袋加上它们的位置，经由与处理文本时完全相同的那套注意力模块。至此你已在一张真实照片上看到了沿途的每一个数——patch 网格、展平向量、位置标记、CLS 词元，以及建立在真实预训练特征之上的注意力热力图。该领域的其余工作则是将其规模化、寻找更好的预训练目标，以及以更低成本重新引入局部性。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n A.src: Final takeaway. A Vision Transformer is a bag of patches plus their positions, poured through the exact same attention block you'd use on text. You've now seen every number along the way—the patch grid, the flattened vectors, the position tags, the CLS token, and the attention heatmap over real pretrained features—on an actual photo. The rest of the field is scaling this up, finding better pretraining objectives, and adding locality back in cheaper ways.
